_readme.purpose: RadiusOS clinical insight rules. Dictation stream -> trigger -> measurement + context -> recommendation text.
how_it_works: 1. If any trigger phrase is heard, the rule activates.
2. Extract the size nearest the trigger and convert to mm (cm x 10). If several lesions are dictated, use the 'measure.use' value (largest or most_suspicious).
3. Read context words (from dictation, clinical history, or order indication) to fill each context key.
4. Walk 'recommendations' top to bottom; the first one whose 'when' conditions all match is output.
5. If a key listed in 'ask_if_missing' is not found, show that prompt instead of guessing.
6. Match the longest phrase first (e.g. 'bosniak 2f' before 'bosniak 2').
7. An empty 'when': {} is the default and always matches; keep it last.
8. 'defaults' fills a context key when nothing is dictated.
9. A rule with 'derive' computes a context key (e.g. TI-RADS level, Bosniak class) from dictated features when the key itself was not dictated.

condition_keys.solid_gt / solid_gte / solid_lt / solid_: solid component size in mm (part-solid nodules)
condition_keys.any other key: must equal the context value, e.g. "menopause": "post"

notes: Bosniak v2019: walls/septa thin <=2 mm, minimally thick 3 mm, thick >=4 mm; nodule = convex protrusion >=4 mm with obtuse margins, or any size with acute margins.
